name: Stone Golem
art_prompt: a hulking stone golem built of rough warm sandstone boulders and slabs, a broad blocky slab torso with carved desert markings, massive heavy stone fists hanging low, short thick stone legs, thin cracks between the stones glowing faint orange, a dark hollow in the head with two glowing ember eyes and no mouth, desert sandstone in ochre, terracotta and pale tan tones, standing squarely and facing the viewer
motion: lumbering in place with slow heavy stomping steps, the huge stone fists swinging a little, dust puffing off its shoulders
anim_negative: extra arms, extra heads, a mouth, a face, wings, the stones separating, a human face, grass, a green ground, a ground plane, pebbles, rubble on the ground, a dust cloud, a shadow on the ground
back_hint: seen from behind: the broad slab back of the torso with carved markings, the back of the blocky head, both stone fists hanging at its sides, no eyes visible
dead_hint: toppled over and lying flat on its back on the ground, dead: the whole body horizontal, a deep crack through its middle, its ember eyes gone dark, both arms spread out limp, nothing else in the picture, no pebbles, no dust, no ground
doc: The Elite that fights at every range: a slow stone golem that smacks the ground in front of it when the hero stands close; from a little further out it marks a half-disc in his direction as wide as the dwarf's wedge and buries it in falling stalactites (one hit and a throw for a hero still inside, the crowd scattered). From anywhere at all it marks a ring the size of the scorpion's burrow on the hero's spot and hurls a boulder across the map onto it: a blast that hurts and throws him and everything else round it.
